sub_fields.label: Order By
sub_fields.name: custom_gallery_orderby
sub_fields.instructions: Selection order only applies when specific posts are chosen below.

sub_fields.label: Layout
sub_fields.name: custom_gallery_layout
sub_fields.instructions: List shows name and role only — no portrait, languages, links or bio.

sub_fields.label: People Type
sub_fields.name: custom_gallery_people_type
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty to show all.

sub_fields.label: Career Type
sub_fields.name: custom_gallery_career_type
sub_fields.instructions: Leave empty to show all.

sub_fields.label: Eyebrow
sub_fields.name: section_eyebrow
sub_fields.instructions: Small capitals above the header.

sub_fields.label: Trust Note
sub_fields.name: trust_note
sub_fields.instructions: Shown next to the Candid seal.

sub_fields.label: Section Header
sub_fields.name: section_header
sub_fields.instructions: Wrap words in *asterisks* to add the yellow highlight.

sub_fields.label: Scroll Prompt
sub_fields.name: jump_text
sub_fields.instructions: Links down to the first Numbered Columns block.

sub_fields.label: Fundraise Up Campaign ID
sub_fields.name: campaign_id
sub_fields.instructions: From the Fundraise Up dashboard: the value after “?form=” in the campaign’s link (starts with F, e.g. FUNABCDEFG). With an ID, the box shows once/monthly and amount buttons; without one, it shows the Checkout Link button.

sub_fields.label: One-time Amounts (USD)
sub_fields.name: once_amounts
sub_fields.instructions: Exactly three whole-dollar amounts, e.g. 50, 100, 250. The middle one is selected first.

sub_fields.label: Monthly Amounts (USD)
sub_fields.name: monthly_amounts
sub_fields.instructions: Exactly three whole-dollar amounts, e.g. 5, 10, 25. The middle one is selected first.

sub_fields.label: Monthly Note
sub_fields.name: note_monthly
sub_fields.instructions: The yearly total (e.g. “$10 a month is $120 a year.”) is added in front automatically.

sub_fields.label: Checkout Link
sub_fields.name: checkout_link
sub_fields.instructions: Used when there is no campaign ID.

sub_fields.label: Checkout Note
sub_fields.name: checkout_note
sub_fields.instructions: Shown under the Checkout Link button.

sub_fields.label: Stats
sub_fields.name: stats
sub_fields.instructions: The numbers update automatically from the site.

sub_fields.label: Items
sub_fields.name: items
sub_fields.instructions: Numbered automatically, three per row.

sub_fields.label: Copy
sub_fields.name: item_copy
sub_fields.instructions: Type {languages} to show the live number of languages in the archive.

sub_fields.label: Stories
sub_fields.name: stories
sub_fields.instructions: The first story is shown large; the rest as cards, three per row.

sub_fields.label: Fellow
sub_fields.name: fellow
sub_fields.instructions: Name, language, country, year and photo come from the fellow’s page.

sub_fields.label: Story Header
sub_fields.name: story_header
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Only the first (large) story shows a header; cards show the fellow’s name.

sub_fields.label: Story Copy
sub_fields.name: story_copy
sub_fields.instructions: Optional. Leave empty to use the fellow’s marketing text. In the first story, wrap words in *asterisks* to add the hand-drawn underline.

sub_fields.label: Display Photos
sub_fields.name: display_photos
sub_fields.instructions: Show fellows’ headshots. When off, each story shows its language name instead.

sub_fields.label: Section CTA
sub_fields.name: section_cta
sub_fields.instructions: Button text and address. With a Fundraise Up campaign, paste the campaign link from the Fundraise Up dashboard (it ends in ?form=…).

sub_fields.label: Section CTA
sub_fields.name: section_cta
sub_fields.instructions: Button text and address. With a Fundraise Up campaign, paste the campaign link from the Fundraise Up dashboard (it ends in ?form=…).

sub_fields.label: FAQ Entries
sub_fields.name: faq_entries
sub_fields.instructions: Pick FAQ posts. The first is shown open.

sub_fields.label: Section Header
sub_fields.name: section_header
sub_fields.instructions: Wrap words in *asterisks* to add the yellow highlight.

sub_fields.label: Section CTA
sub_fields.name: section_cta
sub_fields.instructions: Use #give to scroll back up to the gift box.

sub_fields.label: Display Share Button
sub_fields.name: display_share
sub_fields.instructions: Shows a button that shares or copies the page link.
